rules.title: Project-area evidence
rules.logic: Project area A is calculated from GIS; imagery or GIS must be georegistered and each discrete project area uniquely identified.

rules.title: Root-to-shoot ratio hierarchy
rules.logic: R must follow the specified descending hierarchy by forest type/ecoregion or species/genus/family, with global values validated against direct measurements in the same ecoregion or life-zone.

rules.title: Default emission parameters
rules.logic: GWP uses the most recent IPCC assessment; nitrogen emission factors and fractions use the specified IPCC 2019 values.
rules.source_locator: §9.1 parameters GWPg, EFNdirect, FracGASF, FracGASM, FracLEACH, EFNleach

rules.title: Initial population record
rules.logic: N is established by complete census and each planting-unit record must include unique ID, georeferenced location, year planted and species.

rules.title: Area woody-biomass monitoring
rules.logic: Aboveground woody biomass must use representative unbiased plot sampling, documented QA/QC, fixed size thresholds and appropriately selected or validated allometry; VT0005 does not apply.

rules.title: Non-woody biomass monitoring
rules.logic: Non-woody biomass uses representative plot sampling, minimum/maximum seasonal samples or conservative minimum-stock sampling, at least every five years.

rules.title: Dead-wood monitoring
rules.logic: Standing and lying dead wood require unbiased representative sampling, fixed thresholds, documented protocols, appropriate volume and density methods and monitoring at least every five years.

rules.title: Litter monitoring
rules.logic: Litter uses destructive fixed-frame sampling with dry-mass determination; monitoring occurs at t=0 and at least every five years.

rules.title: SOC monitoring
rules.logic: SOC requires representative stratified sampling to at least 30 cm, matched SOC and bulk-density measurement, equivalent-soil-mass remeasurement, documented protocols and required QA/QC; frequency may not be less than 10 years under the stated low-disturbance conditions.

rules.title: Fertilizer monitoring evidence
rules.logic: Fertilizer mass and content must be monitored at least every five years or before a more frequent verification and quantitative management information must be supported by documentary evidence.

rules.title: Sampled planting-unit record
rules.logic: Randomized sampling from N establishes nt and each sampled-unit record includes unique ID, georeference, year planted and species.

rules.title: Mortality monitoring
rules.logic: Mortality is determined by complete re-enumeration or representative sampling; a unit is dead where green vascular tissue and leaves are absent or the unit cannot be relocated.

rules.title: Census per-unit biomass monitoring
rules.logic: Per-unit biomass requires representative sampling from N, documented QA/QC, fixed thresholds, validated allometry and at least five-year monitoring; live units below the predetermined size threshold receive zero biomass but remain in the sample.

rules.title: Census burned-unit monitoring
rules.logic: Visibly burned and killed planting units are tallied by representative sampling with documented protocols at least every five years.

rules.title: Standard-error estimation
rules.logic: SEp,t must use representative unbiased estimators appropriate to the sample design with documented error checking and outlier procedures.

rules.title: Monitoring-plan minimum content
rules.logic: The monitoring plan must specify approach, tasks, accounting boundaries, measured parameters, collection techniques and sample design, frequencies, QA/QC, electronic archiving, roles, remote-sensing schedule and stocking-index derivation.

rules.title: Monitoring-data retention
rules.logic: All monitoring and QA/QC data must be electronically archived for at least two years after the end of the last project crediting period.

rules.title: Area plot database
rules.logic: Area-based projects must maintain a database with stocking-index derivation, project and control plot IDs, locations, configuration, time series and weights, plus remote-sensing datasets and timestamps.

rules.title: Match-quality threshold
rules.logic: Overall project/control matching is valid only where SDM for every matching covariate is less than or equal to 0.25; otherwise donor-pool radius or k are iteratively adjusted.

rules.title: Control-plot invalidation and replacement
rules.logic: At monitoring, invalid controls are removed, replacements drawn from the donor pool and control weights recalculated to sum to 1.

rules.title: Benchmark time-series minimum sample
rules.logic: Benchmark time series must include t=0 and t plus prior verifications; matched sets missing time-t SI are excluded; at least 30 project plots are required.

rules.title: Z-test significance threshold
rules.logic: Absolute Z equal to or above 1.96 means project and control stocking-index slopes are significantly different.

rules.title: Performance benchmark pathway
rules.logic: If absolute Z is below 1.96 PBt is 1; if absolute Z is at least 1.96 PBt is calculated by Equation A8; an insignificant or negative control slope is set to zero.

rules.title: Stocking-index monitoring
rules.logic: SI must minimize seasonal variability, be monitored at least annually, use a metric demonstrably correlated with carbon stocks, and use the same ex-post metric for project and control plots unless a qualifying harmonized replacement is adopted.

rules.title: De minimis significance procedure
rules.logic: If combined optional-pool and GHG impact is below 5% of expected removals all may be excluded; otherwise include ranked sources through at least 95% and exclude the remainder only if residual combined impact is also below 5% of total removals. Leakage is never part of this de minimis test.

rules.title: Changed-sampling uncertainty procedure
rules.logic: When an area-based inventory approach changes, uncertainty must be calculated across the independent first interval and correlated second interval using Equations A11-A16.
